title: El Toro The Bull
style: 128 bpm, big room progressive house, festival anthem, supersaw lead, trance breakdown, four on the floor, vocal chops, English Spanish Mandarin layered chants
lyrics:
[Intro - whispered, English]
The bull is loose, the gate is open
The operator's word has been spoken

[Verse 1 - Español]
El toro corre, el toro vuela
Veintidós pasos, la fuerza se eleva
Linear doscientos dos en la mente
Notion Hub guarda toda la gente

[Drop - English]
Release the bull, release the bull
Twenty steps deep, the chamber's full
ORICO spinning, the drives are awake
Ready, steady, cool — no mistake

[Verse 2 - 中文]
公牛在跑 公牛在飞
二十二步 力量上升
Linear 二百二 在脑里清晰
Notion Hub 保存所有的人

[Bridge - all three]
El toro — the bull — 公牛
Released — liberado — 释放
La Banda is rolling, Rafa on the wheel
Bongo on the bass, Donatello purple steel

[Final Drop]
Release the bull — ¡suelta el toro! — 释放公牛
Three thirty six, the herd's awake
Hawkeye watching, ZynAsk first
The bull is out — the chain is burst
